comment: The text identifies FHIR as the primary framework for health-data exchange. This is directionally appropriate, but national ecosystems may also need DICOM, HL7 v2, CDA, IHE profiles, openEHR, GS1, and specialised public-health or supply-chain standards.

anchor.note: p.28-29 l.Lines 147-150 read as the printed page; section 2.2.2 agrees

public.text: The text identifies FHIR as the primary framework for health-data exchange. This is directionally appropriate, but national ecosystems may also need DICOM, HL7 v2, CDA, IHE profiles, openEHR, GS1, and specialised public-health or supply-chain standards.
public.suggestedRevision: State that FHIR is the recommended primary framework for new health-data exchange specifications, while established standards should be retained or profiled where they remain appropriate, with governed transformation and migration pathways.
